title: How to Deploy a Cursor Project to Production (Database, Auth, and Hosting in 2 Minutes)
summary: Cursor wrote the code. Now what? Get your AI-built app live with database, auth, and hosting — without wiring Vercel, Supabase, and Auth0 separately. 2-command setup.
body_markdown: Vercel handles only hosting and serverless functions — you still need Supabase for a database, Auth0 for auth, and S3 for file storage. Blink Cloud is a single platform that includes all four. Your Cursor agent can configure and deploy the entire stack in one conversation, without switching between four separate dashboards.
